For Appellant(s) : Mr. Jagdish Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Gaurav Singh, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 17/01/2024

The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14A(2) of the Sc/St (Prevention
of Atrocities) Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with Fir No.287/2022
registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468 and 471 Ipc and Section 3(2)(va) of the Sc/St Act.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned Public Prosecutor for the State and learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the co- accused Kalpesh Kumar @ Kapil Kumar has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 11.10.2023.
Learned counsel submitted that the nature of offences alleged to have been committed by the appellant are triable by Court of [2024:RJ-JD:2705] (2 of 2) [CRLAS-2626/2023] Magistrate.
Learned counsel submitted that the case of the present petitioner is not distinguishable from that of the co- accused Kalpesh Kumar @ Kapil Kumar, who has already been enlarged on bail.
Learned counsel submitted that the appellant is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time to conclude.
Thus, learned counsel prayed that benefit of bail may be extended to the appellant.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, in totality as available on record and upon consideration of the arguments advanced, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 18.12.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge, SC/ ST (Prevention of Atrocities Cases), District Jalore is set aside.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ ST (Prevention of Atrocities Cases), District Jalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is ordered that the accused-appellant -Kalpesh Kumar @ Kapil Kumar S/o Bhaga Ram arrested in connection with FIR No.287/2022 registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Jalore shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided be furnishes a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned lower Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 67-Hanuman/-
